charts.title: WASP-21 b: orbits around Tangra
charts.description: The orbits of Tangra's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-21 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kokori et al. 2023 (2023ApJS..265....4K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KOKORI_ET_AL__2023): P 4.32250416 d

charts.title: WASP-21 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-21 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (56, 83) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 436478932, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 13-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 13-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
